Real-Time Dataflow & Execution Lifecycle

The web interpreter operates in an autonomous real-time loop. Camera frames are processed directly by browser WebAssembly workers and passed through normalizers and sequence buffers before temporal classification and natural language synthesis.

01

Camera Stream Capture

Invokes navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia() requesting facingMode: 'environment' (rear camera) at 1280x720, mounting stream onto HTMLVideoElement.

Source:apps/web/src/vision/camera.tsTarget:apps/web/src/hooks/useCamera.ts
Data PayloadMediaStream track with active video stream
02

MediaPipe Vision Landmark Extraction

Executes detectForVideo() inside requestAnimationFrame loop using MediaPipe FilesetResolver WASM runtime to extract 21 hand landmarks per hand and upper-body pose landmarks.

Source:apps/web/src/vision/mediaPipe.tsTarget:apps/web/src/hooks/useMediaPipe.ts
Data PayloadVisionFrameResult { timestamp, hands: HandDetection[], pose: PoseDetection }
03

Landmark Normalization

Translates hand landmarks relative to wrist origin (0,0,0) and scales by wrist-to-middle-finger Euclidean distance. Translates upper pose relative to shoulder midpoint.

Source:apps/web/src/vision/featureNormalizer.tsTarget:apps/web/src/vision/landmarkProcessor.ts
Data PayloadNormalized Left Hand (63 floats), Right Hand (63 floats), Upper Pose (21 floats)
04

Sequence Buffering

Pushes deterministic 147-dimensional float vector into rolling 30-frame FIFO queue, outputting [30, 147] tensor (4,410 floats).

Source:apps/web/src/vision/landmarkProcessor.tsTarget:apps/web/src/vision/sequenceBuffer.ts
Data PayloadFloat32Array of size 4,410 representing temporal motion
05

Temporal Sign Recognition Model

Passes sequence to ONNX Runtime Web session or Geometric heuristic analyzer (evaluating finger extensions, distance to face, and wrist trajectory).

Source:apps/web/src/vision/sequenceBuffer.tsTarget:apps/web/src/models/ONNXSignModel.ts & GeometricSignClassifier.ts
Data PayloadPrediction { label: string, confidence: number, hindiLabel, category }
06

Prediction Smoothing & Temporal Lock

Applies confidence threshold (>0.80), rolling window majority voting (8 frames), agreement count (>=5), and cooldown (1400ms) to eliminate prediction flickering.

Source:apps/web/src/models/SignRecognitionModel.tsTarget:apps/web/src/translation/predictionSmoother.ts
Data PayloadAccepted stable sign token string + confidence
07

Sentence Construction

Assembles sequence of accepted sign tokens into grammatically fluent English and Hindi sentences respecting ISL Subject-Object-Verb conventions.

Source:apps/web/src/translation/predictionSmoother.tsTarget:apps/web/src/translation/sentenceBuilder.ts
Data PayloadConstructedSentence { english, hindi, tokens: string[] }
08

Text-to-Speech (TTS)

Synthesizes constructed sentence aloud via Web Speech API speechSynthesis with selectable Indian English/Hindi accent and pitch control.

Source:apps/web/src/translation/sentenceBuilder.tsTarget:apps/web/src/speech/textToSpeech.ts
Data PayloadSpeechSynthesisUtterance spoken audio output
